summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 22, 2026, furnishing a copy of a disclosure letter submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange and Securities and Exchange Commission regarding its press release titled 'Going Beyond the Signal: PLDT releases combined 2025 Annual and Sustainability Report.' No transactional terms, stakeholder changes, restructuring, or special-situation event are described. This is a routine report of a non-material disclosure and does not constitute a special situation for event-driven analysis.
